values.subject: Data interpretation
values.answersSummary: Example respondent identified the trend but omitted uncertainty.
values.blueprint: Assess interpretation, evidence use and limits; ask one follow-up at a time.

values.subject: Operational decision-making
values.answersSummary: Example respondent compared options and defended a trade-off.
values.blueprint: Assess counterexamples, constraints and justification; avoid authorship inference.

values.subject: Written argument
values.answersSummary: Example respondent could not explain a term used in the submission.
values.blueprint: Ask for a concrete example before escalating difficulty; score with human anchors.

values.submissionClaims: Example submission claims a controlled comparison of two workflows.
values.verbalResponses: Example respondent explains the measurements but cannot describe the control group.
values.latencyPatterns: Pauses vary from 2 to 12 seconds; timing alone is not authorship evidence.
values.topicGaps: Control-group selection and confounding need follow-up questions.

values.submissionClaims: Example submission uses a complex statistical term.
values.verbalResponses: Example respondent gives a partial definition and one incorrect example.
values.latencyPatterns: Two extended pauses; accommodation and context unknown.
values.topicGaps: Ask a neutral clarification about assumptions; do not infer misconduct.

values.submissionClaims: Example submission describes three implementation stages.
values.verbalResponses: Example respondent describes two stages and disputes a date in the document.
values.latencyPatterns: Latency not recorded; no probability estimate is supported.
values.topicGaps: Clarify version history and contribution boundaries with source evidence.

values.findings: Two reviewers cite the same example of a justified trade-off.
values.blueprint: Use explicit 0–4 anchors and distinguish each competency.
values.appealRisk: Low disagreement in this example; explain the appeal route without predicting outcomes.

values.scores: Human ratings: reviewer A 2/4, reviewer B 4/4 on evidence use
values.findings: Reviewers disagree about whether the cited source supports the conclusion.
values.blueprint: Compare anchored criteria and exact response excerpts.
values.appealRisk: Require reconciliation by an independent reviewer before a final decision.

values.findings: No interaction was recorded for the collaboration criterion.
values.blueprint: Unobserved criteria remain unassessed; do not impute a score.
values.appealRisk: Document missing evidence and provide an opportunity for reassessment.
